changes.oldText: The updated theme cannot be applied immediately from this page. To apply a customized theme, export the configuration as a JSON file and provide it to the support team.

changes.newText: Your edits on this page are a draft: use Preview to check them, then click Apply to save the theme for the domain, where it applies to every user.

changes.newText: Apply: Saves the current settings as the domain's theme.
